neighbours.label: ' to' in future 'going to' + verb (especially 'was not going to stop ...')
fire: My old laptop is going to stop working one of these days.
Losing the first game was not going to stop them from winning the cup.
I really think this summer is going to be very hot.
Not having a map was never going to stop him from exploring the hills.
She told us the new manager is going to change everything.
Our team is going to win the league this year, I am sure.
Being tired was not going to keep her from finishing the race.
Everyone agrees this is going to be the best party of the year.
quiet: My old laptop is in the repair shop until next week.
They went to the stadium to watch the first game of the cup.
I really think this summer we will travel to the coast.
He was going to the hills with a map and a flask of tea.
She told us the new manager starts work on Monday.
Our team is going home right after the match tonight.
Being tired, she sat down on the grass after the race.
Everyone agrees this is the best party of the year.

notes: Card flags broad (2.5% of tokens >0.1 max) and gate-closed (-x- echo 65%); max only 0.93. Probe: 'was not going to stop her' 0.51, 'is going to be' 0.31, 'going to the beach' 0.11, 'want to learn how to cook' 0.17, other 'to' 0.05-0.10.
